Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan now have a huge advantage and they would look to build on that. Still quite a lot of time to go and the hosts will try to bat out Australia (if they haven't already). Australia, on the flip side, will have to do both, contain runs and also take wickets regularly to stand a chance. We have another 17 overs left today. Let us see what happens next...

Now, who did the job for Pakistan? Any guesses? No, it is not Yasir Shah, it is the debutant who has made a huge, huge impact. Bilal Asif spun a web around the Australian batsmen and picked up a 6-fer. Abbas, too, was excellent as he finished with 4. Yasir Shah also bowled well but was a touch unlucky. Wahab Riaz did not get a long run with the ball but still looked off-colour.

One wicket changed the whole complexion of this game. Abbas struck early after Lunch when he removed Finch with a perfectly sorted out plan. Shaun Marsh and Khawaja soon followed and once the latter was dismissed, the rest fell like a pack of cards. None of the batters, except for the top two crossed the 20-run mark. Three Australian batsmen failed to register a run, out of which two were debutants (Head and Labuschagne). A very sorry batting display by them.

SO, PAKISTAN HAVE NOT ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON! Which means they will come out to bat with a massive lead of 280 runs. Who would have thought that when Finch and Khawaja were batting? The two looked at ease with both getting to their half tons. The duo stitched a 142-run stand and at that time, Australia looked like they would too post a big first innings total.

OUT! There was a fielder for the sweep shot and Lyon finds him to perfection. Asif picks up a 6-fer on debut. He tosses this up around middle, Lyon goes for the sweep, connects well but does not keep it down. It goes straight to the fielder at square leg, Azhar Ali there takes it and that is the end of the Australian innings. They have been bowled out for 202.
Works it with the turn to the man at mid-wicket.
The doosra again on off, Lyon goes back and first thinks of defending it but seeing it turn away, he pulls his bat out.

No he does not! Goes for another full, in-dipping delivery but errs in line. It is too much down the leg side. Holland tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Jon Holland is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Four-fer for Abbas. Full and swinging back in from outside off, Siddle goes for the drive by leaving a huge gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and disturbs the furniture behind. The end is nigh for Australia. Abbas on the other hand, has one ball in this over to get a fifer. Will he do so?
Fullish on middle, it is played to mid on.
A huge appeal but not given! Going down leg again! Coming back in a bit too much from middle and it is a little too full. Siddle tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Good length again around off, it comes back in a touch. Siddle tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length on off, kept out.
Another doosra around off, Siddle tries to defend but gets an outside edge through short third man for a run.

Another missed stumping! This one was tougher though. It had a big deflection on its way. Siddle uses his feet and tries to go over the top. He misses and the ball hits his pads and goes towards the right of Sarfraz. He was initially moving to his left and then fails to adjust. The ball goes down to third man and the batsmen take two byes. The umpire did not spot it hitting the pads.
Fires it on off, Siddle tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up on middle, Siddle gets behind the line and blocks it.
Another offie on middle, Siddle swings but misses to get hit on the pads. Sarfraz appeals and Bilal then joins in. The umpire though shakes his head. Going down.
Floats it up on middle, Siddle blocks it out.
Lands it on a length once again, Lyon defends it. Keeps hitting the good length area, Abbas. Very tidy and his figures show how good he has been today!
FOUR! Handy runs these but they need a lot more! Length ball around off, Lyon pushes at it away from his body. He gets an outside edge through the vacant slip region and into the third man fence.
Good length around off, Lyon pushes it to covers.
Again plants his front foot right across and works the in-dipper towards mid-wicket. He needs to connect or he is an LBW candidate.

Just got an inside edge there or Abbas would have had his 4th. Full and this one comes back in very late. Lyon has his front foot planted across and tried to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Another good length delivery on off, the batsman blocks it out.
Flatter delivery on off, kept out.
Siddle tries to copy what his partner is doing but does not succeed. He misses to get hit on his arm. There is an appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Again sweeps it well towards deep square leg for a single.
Dances down the track and strokes it towards mid off for a single.
The doosra on middle, Siddle tries to flick, closes the bat face a touch early and gets a soft leading edge towards mid off.
Brings the sweep shot out, Lyon's favorite shot. He connects well towards deep square leg for a run.
On the pads, Lyon misses the flick, the ball brushes the pads and goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
In the 5th stump channel, Lyon keeps it out.
Nathan Lyon walks out to face the heat. 100th innings for him.

OUT! 8th one down! Abbas gets his third and Starc does not trouble the scorers. Abbas angles this into the off pole which means the batter has to play at it. Gets it to leave after pitching. Starc plays inside the line and the ball kisses the outside edge before going low towards Sarfraz who dives forward and takes a good catch. Third Australian batsman to bag a duck in this innings. 92 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Goes after a wide delivery outside off but due to the lack of bounce, it hits the bottom part of the bat and goes to point.
Around the off pole, Starc makes a leave.
NICE SHOT! Slightly on the shorter side, Siddle stands tall and punches it through covers for a three.
A similar ball but this time Starc plays inside the line and lets it be.
Lovely bowling! Slower through the air outside off, it drifts in. Starc pushes out at the ball but it turns and whizzes past the outside edge.
Slower through the air a little too wide outside off, left alone.
Flatter on the pads, Siddle flicks it through square leg for a run.
Close shave! Siddle goes for the sweep but he drags it a little, the ball goes close past the leg pole and towards fine leg for a couple.
Tosses it up on off, Siddle lunges and keeps it out.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. Dot ball to end the over.
On the fuller side, Starc strokes it to covers again.
Starc strokes it on the up to the man at covers.
On a length around off, defended.
Good length outside off, left alone.
Goes fuller in length on the pads, Siddle flicks it through fine leg and gets to the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of another successful over.
A little too full outside off, it is stroked to covers.
The other one this time, it pitches and goes away. Siddle tries to defend but the ball takes the edge and goes towards short third man for a run.

Extra bounce! Flatter and on the pads, this one takes off after pitching. Siddle lifts his gloves out of the way and the ball hits him on the body and goes towards the short leg fielder. He takes it and lets out another appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Floats it up on middle, Siddle strokes it to mid on.
Peter Siddle is the new man in.

OUT! There is a spike on Snicko and the umpire is asked to stay with his decision. Bilal Asif gets a fifer on debut. He is making a name for himself. Gets rid of the Australian skipper cheaply. Another off spinner pitching outside leg, Paine tries to flick but the ball seems to have taken an inside edge onto his pads. It lobs towards Imam at short leg who takes it and appeals. The umpire, after giving it a thought, raises his finger. Paine is not sure whether he has hit it or not and walks up to the non-striker. He goes for a review after a chat but the replays show that there is bat involved. Australia lose their last recognized batsman and are reeling.
Paine has been caught at short leg. He has been given out by the umpire. He though is not sure whether he hit it or not, walks up to his partner and after a chat reviews.
Bilal Asif is into the attack. So just the one over for Azhar Ali.
A little too wide outside off, MS shoulders arms to it. End of a brilliant over by Abbas, a wicket maiden.
Attacks the stumps, Starc keeps it out.

BEATEN! Not a shot you want to play first up but that is how Starc plays, he will go after anything in his zone. Full and outside off, swinging away. Starc goes for the drive through the off side but gets beaten.
Mitchell Starc is the new man in. He is no mug with the bat and can tonk a few.

OUT! That is plumb in front! Abbas strikes in his first over after the break to put Australia further on the back foot. Excellent in-dipper from him from outside off, it tails back in late. Marsh does not get his bat down in time and the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger straightaway. Marsh too starts walking as he knows he is a goner. Pakistan are into the tail now, they need another 100 runs to avoid the follow-on.
Very little movement into the batsman from around off, Marsh defends it again.
Good length delivery around off, it comes back in a touch. Marsh blocks it out.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end. Strange the ball is not given to Bilal.
Flatter around off, this is a touch quicker, Paine punches it to the man at covers.
Another single! Too short is Ali here, Marsh goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Misfield! Lazy that from the fielder! It was pushed towards him at covers, he does not get down quickly and it goes towards the sweeper for a run.

Sarfraz gets in a second slip seeing the last delivery but Ali ends up bowling a low full toss. Marsh hits it down to long on. The batsmen take one. Paine calls for a second and Marsh responds but the former sends him back in time as the fielder was quick to the ball.

A little bit of turn on this one as it was bowled a touch slower and also tossed up a lot more. Marsh tries to defend but due to the turn, the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards short third man.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on off, no turn on the first one as it was pushed through. Marsh defends it.

We are all set to get the final session underway. It promises to be an action-packed one as we see the umpires along with the Pakistan team stride out to the middle. Tim Paine and Mitchell Marsh also make their way to the middle. Interesting! Azhar Ali to start the final session of the day. Let's go...
... DAY 3, FINAL SESSION ...

Australia were going great guns after their openers put together a big partnership. But once Aaron Finch fell, Pakistan got an opening and they barged through it. Debutant Bilal Asif bowled tremendously and ran riot by picking a 4-wicket haul. Australia's misery against the spinning ball was once again on display as they crumbled. They still require 103 runs to avoid the follow-on and have their final recognized pair in the middle. It's only going to get tough for them from here on. Do join us in a short while for the evening session.

What a great turnaround by Pakistan in the afternoon session! They worked hard in the morning but without any success. Their fortunes changed though as they managed to pick five wickets by conceding just 43 runs and made a completely mockery of Australia's batting. From 142/0, the Kangaroos have slipped to 180/5 and are in a big spot of bother.

Doosra time! Now we have seen almost all variations from these two spinner. He tosses this one up around off. Paine goes back looking to block it but is surprised as the ball turns the other way. However, the Aussie skipper has enough time to adjust his shot and he survives this session. THAT'S TEA.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flighted ball on the off stump line, TP does well to keep it out.
A bit slower and shorter this, Marsh goes back to punch it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Similar ball this a bit outside off, turning in, Marsh defends it.
Full ball on middle, blocked out off the front foot.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman towards the bowler.
A full pitched ball is driven to mid off.
Tossed up on off, Paine lunges ahead in defense.
Flighted ball on off, driven straight back.
The Aussie skipper has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Errs in length and Paine rocks back to punch it through cover-point for a lovely boundary. Needs to play a captain's innings.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bilal is bowling well here and is getting good purchase off the deck. Worrying signs for Australia. Marsh defends this full ball off the front foot.
Marsh shows full face of his bat to this shortish ball on off and defends.
Marsh has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good ball this as he gives it more air and lands it around off, Marsh looking to block it but gets an inside edge.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Beaten! Beauty again from Yasir. Lands this in line wit the stumps and a bit fuller. Paine comes ahead to defend but is completely beaten by the spin. A half-hearted appeal by Pakistan but they knew it was not out.
Paine goes back to this shortish ball on off, punches it to covers.
A bit shorter this as Marsh punches it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, Paine comes right forward to defend it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Paine charges down the ground to this flighted delivery on off and drives it to mid on for a run.
Similar ball and a similar looking block by Paine to survive.
Paine defends it from within the crease.
Slower and a bit shorter of full length, defended from within the crease by the Aussie skipper.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A bit short this, Paine has punched the ball off the back foot.
Mohammad Hafeez to roll his arm now.
Short and on off, punched from the crease to covers.
Fullish and on off, fired in, once again blocked off the back foot.
Quicker one, around off, defended off the back foot. That straightened after pitching. Doosra?
Turning into the batsman from around off, Marsh gets back and punches it down to mid on.
Spin and bounce into the batsman from outside off, Marsh goes back to punch it but finds the fielder on the off side.
Lets the ball spin back into him and then defends it off his front foot to short leg.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Flighted around off, worked into the mid-wicket region.

This is the last thing Australia will hope for - a run-out. Yasir tosses this up on off, Paine drives it to mid off and takes off. The man there does well to pick it up clean and hit the target at the striker's end. Pakistan feel they have a run out here as the umpire has referred it upstairs. Replays show that Marsh is in but he would have had his heart in his mouth for a while. Everything has started to happen now.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Marsh pushes this shortish delivery through covers to get off strike.
Full on off, driven to cover.
A run-out appeal against Marsh has been referred upstairs. With direct hits you never know.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A double-wicket maiden.
Skipper Tim Paine is in next.

OUT! HALF THE SIDE IS OUTTA HERE! Bilal, on debut, is on fire. He gets his second scalp in the over as he flights this one around middle and off. Labuschagne comes forward to defend but the ball turns and bounces more than he expected. It takes the inside edge onto his pads and lobs to Imam-ul-Haq at short leg. The Pakistan team is celebrating wildly as they feel they have got a firm grip now on this match. So, the Pakistani debutant has removed two of the Australian debutants in a space of three balls, with both bagging a duck. This is sensational bowling by the offie. Australia need 112 more to avoid the follow-on.
Wide down the leg side, no trouble at all for the batsman.
Marnus Labuschagne is the new batsman. He is also on his international debut.

OUT! The fourth one falls! Wonderful spin bowling on show here. Pakistan have turned things around in a span of 30 minutes. Bilal again gives this one more air and keeps it on off. Head, who has just come in, goes for the cover drive. The ball lands and spins away, taking the outside edge and it flies to second slip where Haris Sohail takes a beauty by diving low to his left. Pakistan will now look to run through the Aussie batting line-up.
Slower and shorter on leg, Head goes back to block it out.
Tossed up on off, driven to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! A gift from Yasir and gleefully accepted by Marsh. The leggie gives it air, a bit too much though as it is a full toss and Marsh flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket to get a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shah slows it down a bit and keeps it marginally shorter than full, Marsh goes back and punches it to covers.
Pretty much identical this delivery and also the shot.
Very full delivery in line with the stumps, Marsh drives gently to mid off.
Beaten again! Beautifully bowled delivery. It drifts in around off and then spins away, Head draws forward to defend but is beaten by the off spin.
Shortish and on middle, Head works it off his hips but finds the backward square leg fielder.
Quicker and flatter this time, a bit short as well, Head goes on his back foot and defends it down. Sarfraz collects the ball on one bounce.
Loopy and on off, it's played down with the spin to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back off the front foot.
Flighted ball landing outside off and spinning away, Head is on the front foot in defense but gets beaten.
Marsh defends it from within the crease and ends an interesting over.
Outside off and left alone by the batsman.
Tossed up around off, Marsh does well to come forward and defend.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Keeps it wide of off, Marsh shoulders arms to let that one through.

DROPPED! Caught and bowled chance goes down and Yasir has no one else but himself to blame for missing this simple opportunity. He flights it nicely and keeps it around off. Marsh drives uppishly straight to the bowler. It pitched in the rough may be and that is why Mitchell could not control his stroke. The ball though bursts through Yasir's hands and hits him in the chest. He is seen sitting down with some pain, physical and also the pain of dropping the catch.
Yasir Shah to continue. He will also like to get among the wickets.
Debutant Travis Head is the new batsman in with Australia in a spot of bother.

OUT! A risky attempt by Usman Khawaja and he has thrown away his wicket. A start wasted. Asif bowls it flatter through the air and it skids on after landing with some extra bounce. Khawaja opts for the paddle sweep but the length is not the ideal one to do so. It takes the top edge of his bat and balloons in the air. Imam-ul-Haq moves across to his left from short leg to take a simple catch. A big wicket this for Pakistan as they get rid of the set batsman.
FOUR! Firmly stroked! Flighted and full delivery outside off, Usman Khawaja kneels and sweeps it in front of square leg for a cracking boundary.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Extra slower through the air, at 78.6 kph, Marsh goes on the back foot and punches it to long on for a run.

Loopy off spinner landing outside off, Marsh is on the front foot in defense but misses. It goes off his pads to first slip where the fielder dives to his left to catch it but puts it down. Was there an edge? Maybe, just missed the inside edge.
Turning in from around off, Marsh is on the front foot in defense.
Walks down the track and drives it towards mid off to end the over.
A googly landing around leg and bounces a bit more than expected. Khawaja goes back to work it around but is beaten and gets it away from the higher half of his bat.
Plays with the spin. Full and on off, Mitchell draws forward and drives it through covers for a run.
Flighted leg spinner again, on middle, Marsh lunges and defends.
Loopy leg spinner landing too full on middle, Marsh is on the front foot as he pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, a bit short and around off, Mitchell goes on the back foot in defense.
This one straightens after landing on the rough outside off, Marsh allows it through to the keeper. Top over by the debutant, a wicket and a run from it.
Full floated off spinner on off, Marsh tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls to square leg. They cross for a hesitant single.
A touch flat and on off, defended off the back foot.
Fullish and on off, defended off the front foot.
Mitchell Marsh is the new batsman.

OUT! Another one bites the dust and the debutant Bilal Asif gets his first Test wicket. A generously tossed up delivery outside off. Tempting the batsman. Marsh is lured into a cover drive but the ball spins away after kissing the deck and takes an outside edge to first slip. Asad Shafiq grabs the catch over his head this time as Australia lose their second wicket. A big blow to the Aussies as Shaun has a good record batting in Asia.
Loopy and full outside off, turning away, Marsh leans forward and pushes it to point.

Drinks. A much-better hour for Pakistan. They have managed to dismiss Aaron Finch owing to a great strategy and with the ball spinning, the Asian team will be eyeing more wickets. Usman Khawaja is going strongly for Australia and he will hope that Shaun Marsh sticks around with him. Expect plenty of spin dose in the next 60 minutes.
Very full and on off, hit firmly but once again back to the bowler.
Comes from over the wicket for Khawaja. Serves it full and outside off, Usman comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full this time and Marsh drives it with the spin to mid on for a single.
Lets the ball to turn back in from the rough outside off and then dead-bats it safely.
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and full outside off, Marsh gets forward and across before defending it t the leg side.

Top edge but safe! Usman loses his patience this time. He sees the line to be too straight and length to be too full and immediately sits down on one knee for the slog sweep. Fails to middle his shot and it goes in the air over mid-wicket. Falls in no man's land in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Well bowled! The best delivery of the over. Flighted and full outside off, Khawaja gets lured into a cover drive but is beaten by the away spin.
Closer to the off stump this time, it's on the shorter side again and Usman plays it off his back foot to point.
Short and wide outside off, trying to tempt the batsman, Khawaja though lets it be.
Floated and full outside off, turning away, the batsman leaves it alone.
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to short cover.
Bilal Asif comes back into the attack. A slip and a short leg in place to start with for the southpaw

Big spin on this occasion. Landing outside off and turning in sharply, Marsh is forward in defense but misses. He is trapped on the pads, they appeal but it's spinning too much and would have missed the stumps.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning back in, Marsh gets forward and defends it back with a straight willow.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps a full ball down to fine leg for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in and works it past the diving leg gully fielder. The short fine leg fielder is a bit late in reacting and they cross for a run, much to Sarfraz' disappointment.
Full and flighted on off, defended back to the bowler.

Flighted delivery landing outside off and turning into the batsman. Khawaja easily works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run. Plenty of rough outside the left-hander's off stump and Shah will be looking to exploit that.
Yasir Shah to operate for the first time in this session. He has been wicket-less so far but things could change now.
Marsh has played that off the front foot and into the ground. A maiden!

Beaten by a beauty! Abbas delivers this one from wide of the crease. He dishes out a back of a length ball around off and it straightens from there. The angle made the batsman play at it but then it straightens to beat the bat. Marsh was clueless.
Pitches it up and wide outside off, Marsh plays a confident drive but finds the cover fielder.

Better line and length. He pitches it full and in the middle stump line. The ball straightens a touch and Marsh does well to defend it from the crease. The 'round the wicket angle along with this line - a dangerous proposition for the southpaw.
Azhar Ali has a chat with the bowler.
Another delivery in the channel outside off, holding its line, Marsh shoulders arms. Abbas needs to pitch it up more.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR! Nicely played! Wahab digs in a short delivery but it lacks direction. It's around leg and Usman gets on top of the bounce before pulling it fine down the leg side for a boundary. A good end to the over for Australia.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Full and moving back into the batsman, Marsh is on the front foot as he defends it back. There are a couple of catchers on the leg side in a close-in position, at mid-wicket. So Shaun needs to be careful with his flick shots. Can't afford to be loose there.
Bowls it with a slingy action and drops it on a length outside off, Khawaja stays back to play it through backward point for a run.
Wahab is definitely getting the reverse swing now. Fails to get the direction right this time though. He bowls it down the leg side and Usman fails to get any wood behind it.
Angling into the batsman, from around off, Khawaja keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks it.
Drops it on a length outside off, Marsh decides to play this from the crease. He does so off the bottom half of his blade.
Gets on the front foot this time to a length ball outside off and blocks it watchfully.
Good length ball on off, Shaun defends it solidly this time.

EDGY FOUR! Excellent delivery. Straightening after pitching. It's angling in around off and Marsh pushes inside the line, flat-footed. It goes off the outside edge, through the gap between first slip and gully, and reaches the fence. Moral victory for the bowler.
On a length and outside off, going straight on, Marsh covers the line and shoulders arms.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Angles in a length ball on off, Khawaja brings down a straight bat in defense.
Serves a length ball on middle and off, some reverse there, Khawaja clips it in the gap at mid-wicket and collects a couple.
Back of a length delivery on off, Usman goes on the back foot and defends it back.
Khawaja has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lands it around off, on a length, it's defended off the front foot.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left alone. End of a successful over, a wicket maiden.
Shortish and on off, blocked off the back foot.
Shaun Marsh is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Finch is gone! Excellent low catch by Asad Shafiq. The ploy to have a silly mid on has worked. Abbas with a full length delivery strikes. He angles it into the batsman and Finch tries to hit it down the ground. Goes at with firm hands, middles it decently but fails to keep it down. It's dying down in front of Shafiq who shows extremely good reflexes to grab it inches above the surface. Pakistan can celebrate, finally. A well-planned breakthrough. The 142-run stand has been broken.
Once again covers the line and forces it out on the leg side.
Gets behind the line and defends it.

Excellent piece of fielding resulting in a confusion between the batsmen. Finch has flicked a full ball off his pads to square leg where Bilal Asif dives full length to his right to stop the ball. Initially Aaron looks for a run and Khawaja responds by rushing mid-way down the track. Then the southpaw is sent back after the fielding effort. Sarfraz goes to pat on the back of the young man.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot to end the over.
Slips it down the leg side, Khawaja clips it fine down the leg side for a couple of runs.

Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to covers. Interesting conversation going on between Waqar Younis and Ramiz Raja. The latter asks the former about the players who hail from Islamabad and have played Test cricket. Waqar names Mohammad Akram and then after some hints by Ramiz, mentions Usman Khawaja. The whole point of asking this question was that Rameez wanted to say that Khawaja knows Urdu and Sarfraz will have to talk in some other language while having a chat with his players. Hmm...
Back of a length ball on off, Khawaja eases himself on the back foot and punches it towards cover-point.
Terrific delivery. A hint of reverse there. Riaz serves it on a length around off, Khawaja covers the line and blocks it out.
Full and angling in on middle and leg, Khawaja leans forward and across before flicking it off his pads. Good timing but wrong placement. Straight to square leg.
A length ball on off, a hint of inward shape, Aaron plays it down from the back foot to covers.
Shortish and on off, defended off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
On and around off, Finch stays back footed as he defends it back. The replay shows a big overstepping by the bowler but it goes unnoticed as the umpire failed to spot it. Hmm...
Action replay of the last delivery. Abbas is doing well to make the batsman play every ball. Also, he is bowling as per the field.
Identical to the last delivery, once again it's angled in the direction of the middle stump, Finch watches it carefully before playing it with soft hands to the leg side.
A length ball on off, angling in, Finch closes the face of the bat and helps it to short mid-wicket.
Hitting the bat hard, Wahab. Bends his back to deliver a shortish ball on off, Usman goes on his toes to defend it down on the off side.
Good delivery, angling in around off, a bit of reverse too. Khawaja keeps his weight on the back foot and blocks.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Loses his radar and slips a length ball down the leg side. Khawaja tries to flick but misses and it's collected by Sarfraz behind the stumps.
Shout for an lbw! But the umpire remains unmoved. Wahab angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Khawaja fails to flick and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but it's missing leg.
Back of a length delivery on off, at 140.3 kph, Khawaja offers a straight bat in defense. Solid.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman, Finch watchfully defends it to the off side. Maiden!
Shortish and on off, punched off the back foot to silly mid off. The fielder there picked the ball and immediately turned to look at the non-striker but Khawaja was well in.
Fuller and straighter, it's flicked off the pads but straight to the square leg fielder.
Angling into the batsman, wicket-to-wicket line, Finch is behind the line as he defends it to the leg side.
Shortish and on off, Finch stays back to punch it through the line but it takes the inner half of his blade and rolls to square leg.
A length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end. No slip, only a gully in place. A silly mid off and silly mid on are present though, right in the face of the striker.
On a length around off, Finch stays back to play it quietly down to third man for a run.

Nice drive and partially stopped. An overpitched delivery outside off, Finch plays the square drive with good timing and the cover-point fielder dives across to his left to take the pace off the ball. A couple of runs taken.
Good length ball outside off, staying a bit low. Finch remains on the back foot, keeps his eyes glued to the ball and defends.
Very full in length and wide outside off, Finch drives it off the toe end of his bat to short cover.
Angles in a full ball on off, Aaron gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Makes the batsman drive first ball. Bowls it wide outside off, Finch strokes it off his front foot but finds the cover fielder.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The men concerned are back on the field. Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja to resume their innings. Pakistan to begin with the pace of Wahab Riaz. The left-arm pacer was wayward in the morning and was also warned once for running on the danger area. Let's see how he does in this spell. A slip in place. Here we go...
... DAY 3, THIRD SESSION ...

The Aussie openers have somehow managed to survive the session. They would look to continue and stay out there in the middle as long as possible. The home team, on the other hand, will be keen on taking a few quick wickets post the break and make the match interesting, for them and for us. Do join us in a short while for the post-Lunch session.

107 runs in 33 overs without losing a wicket. If someone would have asked the Aussies as to what kind of a start would they wish on Day 3, this would have been their answer. Both Finch and Khawaja have done well by mixing aggression with caution. The Pakistan spinners have certainly troubled the batters once in a while. A couple of chances worth mentioning are the missed stumping opportunity of Khawaja and also his bat-pad catch which was not referred to by Pakistan.
Flighted ball attacking the stumps, Khawaja defends from the crease with a straight bat. THAT'S LUNCH. Australia trail by 345 runs and need 146 more to avoid the follow-on with all wickets in tact.
Shorter in length outside off, Finch punches it through cover-point to get off strike.
A bit flatter and in line with the leg stump, Finch flicks the ball off his pads to square leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A bit shorter outside off, Usman punches this through covers for a single.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, Khawaja waits for the ball to arrive and flicks it gently into the square leg region to pick up a brace.
Similar ball this but from over the wicket. Finch defends coming forward.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Too wide down the leg side, Finch leaves it alone.
Tossed up from around the wicket, lands it very full on leg stump, Finch blocks it out.
Flighted and full outside off, the southpaw gets down and cracks the sweep straight to the man at deep backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up around off, Usman keeps it out from within the crease.
A touch short and on off, Aaron goes on the back foot in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shout for an lbw, not entertained. Asif from 'round the wicket bowls a slider, Finch fails to work it around and is hit on the pads. They appeal but it had pitched outside leg.
Flighted and on off, defended off the back foot.

Flatter and shorter on off, turning back in, Finch goes deep inside the crease and punches it through covers. They take a couple as Abbas mops it up in the deep. Nahi...nahi...nahi.. was the reaction from Sarfraz after watching that length.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked on the leg side, found short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

NOT OUT! The impact is with the umpire's call. Yasir has tossed this one around off, Khawaja gets down to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls down to the fine leg region and the batsmen cross over for a brace. But the Pakistan players go up in a big appeal for an LBW. The umpire gives it not out and the bowler and the skipper have a chat before reviewing it. The replays show that the impact is umpire's call. Review saved and Usman survives.
Review for LBW taken. Yasir Shah this time has convinced his skipper. Is the impact outside off?
Usman goes for the sweep but misses to get rapped on the pads. However, the impact is clearly outside off.
Full and on off, Usman drives this through covers to get another brace.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the southpaw. A similar ball is similarly played by the southpaw. The only difference is that this time he plays it much finer. The ball flies past the first slip fielder for another boundary. The reverse sweep looks good when it comes out well, otherwise it makes you look like a fool. So far so good by Usman, although risky.

FOUR! The leggie gives some air and keeps it in line of the stumps, Khawaja though gets the reverse sweep out and this time he cracks it perfectly. The connection is so good that the ball races across the backward point region.
Floated off spinner on off, Aaron lunges and defends it close to his front pad.
Loopy delivery landing full on middle. Spinning down and Finch takes it on his pads by offering no shot.
Turning back into the batsman from around off, Aaron remains back and works it off his pads to short fine leg.
Once again Khawaja gets down the track to a full ball and forces it down to mid on for a quick single.
Spin and bounce outside off, Usman leaves it alone and Sarfraz jumps a bit while collecting the ball.
Uses his feet to get down the track and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Fullish and on off, defended back from the front foot to end the over. Fourth maiden in a row for Pakistan. Good pressure bowling.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter and on off, it's punched back off the back foot by Finch.
Full and flighted on off, Finch leans forward and defends it back.
Tossed up ball wide outside off, Finch offers no shot and covers his stumps with his front pad. Lack of bounce visible there.
Loopy ball on off, defended off the front foot.

BIG APPEAL BUT TURNED DOWN. Beautiful bowling again by Asif as he lands this full and on middle. Khawaja tries to block it from his crease but is beaten to get rapped on the pads. The ball flies to first slip who grabs it and a big appeal ensues. The umpire is unmoved though as there was no bat there and the impact too was outside off.
Gets squared up by this wonderful ball by Asif. He tosses this around off, Khawaja tries to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball rolls towards the slip region, no harm done.
Slower and shorter, Usman goes back and punches this to covers.
Tossed up on middle and defended from within his crease.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller ball around off is driven to covers.
Slower on off, Finch defends it from within the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Just short of the short mid-wicket fielder. Finch seeing the length to be on the shorter side, goes back and pulls it hard but a bit uppishly towards mid-wicket. The ball bounces in front of the fielder there who stops it well. Both batsman and bowler will feel they missed out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, Finch again is happy to defend it.
Full on middle, Aaron lunges forward in defense.
Defended off the front foot by Usman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tad fuller in length around of, pushed through covers.
The southpaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This time he goes back and keeps this full ball out.
A bit slower and shorter this, played towards the point region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Some patience from Finch as he stays back to block it off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Nearly drags it on. Lovely bowling! Yasir gives his googly a bit more air, enticing Aaron to go for a big shot. Finch obliges and swings his bat, looking to hit it over the long on region, probably. But the ball spins in and takes the inside edge before going down towards fine leg. A couple taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Aerial but safe. Guess Usman is going to sweep his way out against the spinners. The southpaw again goes down to this fuller delivery on off and tries to sweep. Fails to middle it properly but falls short of square leg. A run taken.

13th Test fifty for Usman Khawaja! This is also his highest Test score in the subcontinent. So far, he has passed the spin test, although he got lucky a couple of times. He reached his milestone by playing a paddle sweep fine down the leg side for three runs. Justin Langer is standing and applauding inside the dressing room. Australia will hope he carries on.
Usman kneels and sweeps this nonchalantly through square leg to get a couple of runs.
Leg bye! Flatter and quicker this, Finch tries to flick but the ball hits his pads and rolls towards square leg, they pinch a leg bye.
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot.
Errs in line and lands this full ball a bit outside leg, Aaron delicately nudges this fine into the leg side to get a brace.
Tossed up around off, flicked to mid-wicket.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
INTERESTING CHOICE OF SHOT! Khawaja goes down and to everyone's surprise plays the reverse sweep. The connection is good but he finds the fielder at point.
Full ball on off, driven crisply to mid-wicket.
Flighted and full again on off, Aaron drives this through covers to get a run.
Tossed up on off, Finch defends it towards cover-point.
Full and outside off, turning into Usman, the southpaw gets down and sweeps this to backward square leg to change strike.
Sliding down the leg side, Finch fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg. A couple of leg byes taken.
Loopy on off, Aaron Finch  has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted and on off, defended again off the front leg.
Aaron has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy full ball on off, defended off the front foot by Finch.

FOUR! Maiden Test fifty for Aaron Finch! And he reaches there in style. Gets down on one knee to a full ball outside off and plays a crunching sweep shot in front of square leg. There is a fielder in the deep but he got no chance of stopping it. We all know the kind of power Aaron possesses. That went like a tracer bullet. He raises his bat towards his dressing room. This is the first half century by an Australian opener on debut in Asia. Also, the 100-run stand is up.
Slower and full on off, Finch drives this to long on to get single and retain strike.
Finch showing good patience and temperament as he is happy to defend this flighted full ball around off from the front foot.
Full and slow again, Finch lunges forward and blocks with a straight bat.
Tossed up around off, Aaron comes forward and keeps it out.
Khawaja sweeps this full length ball to square leg and takes a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Appeal for an LBW again but turned down once more. Finch looking to block this off the front foot gets hit on the pads as he is beaten by the spin. This results in a big appeal. The umpire is unmoved as the impact is outside the line of off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted and full around off, Finch drives it to mid on.
This time though the southpaw leans across and drives it through covers to exchange strike.
Fuller this on off, Usman drives this to mid on.
Starts his spell with a tossed up delivery around off, Khawaja stays back in his crease and defends.
Spin from both ends now. Bilal Asif is into the attack.
A bit full this around off which allows the southpaw chance to drive it with the spin through mid on for one.
Tossed up around off, Khawaja looking to block gets beaten to get rapped on the pads, but luckily for him the impact is outside off.
Full and down leg, Aaron tucks this fine of the square leg fielder for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, kept out off the front foot.
FOUR! Flighted and full but a bit down the leg side, Finch gets down and sweeps magnificently through backward square leg for a boundary.

Well...well...well... We're now getting to watch the replay of 28.6 and the Snicko has detected some spike. So, Pakistan have missed a trick. Khawaja gets another life. Yasir Shah was so sure in his appeal but failed to convince his skipper for the review. An opportunity gone.
FOUR! Shot! Riaz lands it full and outside off, Khawaja drives it crisply past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Fullish and angling in on middle, Khawaja gets behind the line and pushes it back.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
A full toss down the leg side, Khawaja whips it behind square leg for a run.
Fullish and angling in on middle, Khawaja defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery angling down the leg side, Finch doesn't middle his flick shot well and it goes off the inside edge to fine leg. A single taken.

Drinks break. A very good hour for the Australians. They have not lost any wicket which is the crucial part and both their openers have looked decent. Having said that, it's spinning and bouncing and they cannot afford to relax. Pakistan have bowled well but without any success. The missed stumping chance of Usman Khawaja was the closest they got to breaking the partnership. Still, they will be hopeful of picking up a few wickets before the lunch break. Let's see how the next half pans out.

BIG APPEAL BUT NOT OUT! Khawaja lunges to the last ball before the drinks break but misses his defense to get hit on the pads. The ball again is caught by the short leg fielder. This time the men from Asia go up in a loud appeal but the umpires rejects their claim. No DRS taken. Yasir though looked very much convinced. Anyway, the opening pair has survived the first hour.
Similar ball and similarly defended by Aaron.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

The southpaw survives. Yasir flicks this and keeps it a bit shorter than full around off, Khawaja skips down the track to play an aggressive shot but the ball turns in sharply along with some extra bounce, hits Khawaja's pads and loops up in the air wide of short leg.
Tossed up and on of spinning in, Usman defends from within the crease.
Probably the last over before the much-needed drinks break, Yasir starts it by bowling a full ball around off, Khawaja drives back to the bowler.

Switches to 'round the wicket for the right-hander and angles in a length ball on off, Finch defends it from the back foot to end the over. A pretty ordinary one by Wahab, struggled with his line and length and landing.
This is poor bowling. Seems Wahab's mind is now more on his landing than his line. Too straight again and Khawaja eases it through square leg for three runs.
Fullish and outside off, driven straight to wide mid off.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time. Wahab once again serves a short delivery around off, Usman uses the depth of his crease to get back and slap it past the point fielder. A boundary results

Straightaway the line changes from middle and leg to outside off. But the length is on the shorter side and Khawaja will be disappointed to not put that away. He cracks it off his back foot but finds the point fielder. Here comes the first official warning as well for Wahab Riaz. The umpire was keeping a close eye on his landing and this time has given the warning. Riaz now needs to be careful.
Sarfraz walks up to his bowler and has a little chat with him. Maybe, reminding him to bowl according to the field.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Khawaja flicks it off his pads but finds the fielder standing in front of square leg.
Flighted around off, Finch stays back in his crease and blocks it down.

Beaten! Yasir bowling nicely but will be hoping for some luck in this burning heat. He tosses this full and on middle stump line. Aaron prods forward looking to defend but gets beaten because of some prodigious away spin.
Full on off, driven to mid off.
Flighted around off, Finch shoulders arms as it spins away into the keeper's gloves.
A bit slower and straighter, Khawaja turns this to square leg and gets off strike.
Full around off, Khawaja tries to drive a low full toss but ends up slicing it past backward point to get a brace.
A bit short again outside off, punched towards covers to end the over.
Fuller in length but on Finch's pads. He defends it into the mid-wicket region.
Finch shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fractionally shorter in length around off, Finch stands tall and punches this to covers.
Similar ball on a good length around off, Finch defends from within his crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Looks like the Aussie openers want to be aggressive against the leggie and put him under pressure. Clever tactics, if it comes off though. Khawaja this time skips down the track looking to flick it into the leg side but the ball spins into him and takes the inside edge towards backward square leg. A couple taken. End of an expensive over by Yasir.
Good batting this from Finch as he goes back to this short delivery outside off and punches it through covers for a single.

SIX! KABOOM! That came out of nowhere, but we can expect this from the attacking right-hander. Yasir gives it air and keeps it very full. Aaron from within his crease takes a big stride forward before swinging his blade against the turn. He gets it away from the middle of the bat and it flies over long on for a biggie.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flighted again on middle, Finch defends but the ball takes the outer half and rolls towards the slip region. Good turn there for Yasir.
The leggie starts with a tossed up ball on off, Finch comes forward in defense.
Hurls across a length delivery pretty wide outside off, Khawaja lets it through to the keeper to end the over.
Once again Usman remains inside the crease to a length ball outside off and keeps it out safely.
Around off on a length, slanting in, Khawaja defends it from the crease.
Angling into the batsman, Khawaja turns it off his pads again but this time finds the fielder at mid-wicket.

FOUR! Cracking shot! He is not letting any loose ball go unpunished. Wahab dishes out a short of a length delivery wide outside off, Usman camps back and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Starts with a straight delivery. Around middle and leg, Khawaja clips it behind square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Wahab Riaz to have a go now.

FOUR! Handsomely punched! A bit shorter than full length again by Yasir around off, Finch looks settled now as he goes back and punches this through the gap at covers to get his second boundary of the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! 50-run opening stand comes up for the Aussies. Good start, this. Shah errs in length and lands this a bit shorter outside off, Finch rocks back and cuts it handsomely through point for a boundary.

Beaten! Just beautiful bowling! Classic leg spin on show here. Yasir gives this a bit more air and keeps it around off, Finch looking to defend it is completely beaten as the ball turns sharply and goes past his outside edge into Sarfraz's mitts.
A bit slower and outside off, Finch thinks of going after it but leaves it at the last moment.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
This time Usman drives this full length ball on off straight to covers.
Full and fast but a bit wide of off, Khawaja shoulders arms.
Fuller in length and on middle and off, Usman defends it from within the crease.
The southpaw chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Good length and just outside off, Khawaja looking to defend misses it to get beaten.

Stifled appeal for am LBW! Abbas lands this on a good length around middle and leg, Aaron trying to flick but misses it to get rapped on the pads. The Pakistan go up in a half-appeal and then bail out as the ball is clearly going down leg. They pinch a single as it rolls into the gap at square leg.
Tossed up around off, driven to mid off.
Similar ball, similar shot attempted and the same result as the ball rolls down to the fielder at short fine leg.
Again a bit fuller and slower outside the off stumps, Usman looking to defend it beaten by the prodigious turn as the ball hits his pads and goes to short fine leg.
A bit fuller in length, worked with the turn to short leg.
Nice bowling as Yasir gives it a bit more air and keeps it full on off, Aaron drives this through covers and jogs across for a run.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, Finch comes forward in defense.
The southpaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery to end the over.
A bit fuller than good length around off, looking to get some movement maybe, Usman though defends this easily with a straight bat.
Abbas now from around the wicket keeps it on a good length around off, Usman defends it from his crease.
A bit shorter this outside off, Finch punches into the gap at cover-point and takes a quick single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Attacking the corridor around off is Abbas, Finch keeps it out easily off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, Usman comes forward to defend but misses it to get rapped on the pads, but the impact is outside the line.
A bit shorter outside off, Aaron rocks back and punches it through covers to get off strike.
Usman plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up in line with the spin, Khawaja is being positive as he flicks this through mid-wicket to get a brace.
Similar ball by Shah and similarly blocked out by Khawaja.
Yasir starts the new over with a slow flighted and fuller ball around off, Usman comes forward in defense.
Good line and length, around off, Finch defends it solidly from the crease. A tidy over by Abbas apart from the first delivery.
Straighter delivery, worked off the pads to square leg.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Finch punches it behind off the outer half of his bat and the gully fielder dives across to his right to stop the ball.
Identical to the last delivery, once again getting some shape into the batsman, Aaron does well to defend it with soft hands to short mid-wicket.
A short mid-wicket in place. So two fielders in the catching position on the leg side.
Better line. Around off and moving back in a bit, Finch plays this one close to his front pad and closes the face of his bat to defend it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Abbas runs in with a silly mid on in place. He though serves it too straight, around middle and leg and Finch tickles it fine off his pads to the fine leg fence.
Similar delivery and the southpaw shows good patience by staying in his crease and blocking it out.
Flighted ball on off, Usman prods forward and defends it.

STUMPING CHANCE MISSED! Beautiful bowling by the leggie as he has completely foxed the southpaw. Khawaja, looking to unsettle Yasir, skips down the track. Shah has tossed it up around off, Usman tries flicking it with the turn but the nut spins more than the batsman expected and misses his bat and pads. It goes behind to Sarfraz who also misses it and the ball runs away to the fine leg fence for four byes. Some better keeping from the skipper could have got them their first wicket. Khawaja survives and needs to be careful with his footwork. The key is not to overdo it.
Defended off the back foot by the southpaw.
Slower and fuller on off, Khawaja flicks it to mid-wicket.

Good bowling, almost got him. Yasir tosses this up and keeps it in line with the stumps, Finch lunges forward and tries to block this with a straight bat in front of his pads. But the ball skids through to take the inside edge and rolls towards square leg for a single.
Dishes this a bit fuller, the southpaw strokes it to mid on to end the second maiden in a row.
Length ball around off is blocked out off the back foot.
Straighter ball attacking the stumps is turned away towards mid-wicket. Looks like the pair is settling themselves down and studying how the pitch is behaving before starting to play their shots.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Similar ball around off and similarly kept out off the back foot.
Abbas from around the wicket lands it on a good length around off, Khawaja defends from within the crease.
Full length flighted ball around off is driven to covers to end the maiden over.
A bit quicker and straighter this, Finch works it into the square leg region.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Being watchful here is Aaron as he comes forward and blocks this fuller delivery around off.
Tossed up and full, Finch prods forward in defense.
Starts with a slower and shorter ball on off, Aaron punches into the covers.
Pakistan wasting no time as they straightaway introduce spin from the other end. Yasir Shah to start to roll his arm.
Hurls a length delivery in the channel outside off, going straight on, Khawaja shoulders arms to end the first over of the day.
Lands it on a length just outside off, Khawaja once again commits himself into the shot from the back foot and pushes it out with an angled bat to cover-point.
This one is angled in around off, Khawaja has to play at it and does so from the back foot. Keeps it out safely on the off side.
In the channel outside off, Khawaja is not too bothered as he leaves it alone.

Abbas switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander. Angles in a length ball around off, Khawaja defends it watchfully. All eyes will be on him today. How he fares against spin is the real question?
A good confident beginning. Slightly short in length around off, Finch goes back and punches it through covers. The ball stops in the deep and they take three runs.
Time to get underway! Mohammad Abbas to start proceedings. Aaron Finch on strike. A slip in place. Here we go...

Brendon Julian is seen interviewing Mitchell Marsh who says it was nice to get their feet up and relax after spending such a long time in the field. Adds that they did well yesterday to bowl out Pakistan and then the start by their openers was also good. Reckons that the track will stay flat and they will be looking to grind it out today without losing many wickets. States that it is all about trying to settle your nerves and not worrying about the runs. Feels that the most vital thing is staying out there in the middle. Mentions that it is hard to bat against reverse swing but they have trained hard to tackle it. Ends by saying that getting a first innings lead is still a long way away as they are currently focusing on batting well and staying out there as long as possible.

Warm welcome, folks. A couple of days into this Test match and Pakistan find themselves in front, all thanks to a strong batting performance. They have posted a 450-plus first innings total and with the pitch expected to take spin, they hold the aces. In fact, the last hour of play yesterday saw the Aussie openers tackle the Pakistan pace attack with considerable ease. However, Yasir Shah definitely gave them some nervous moments, especially Aaron Finch, and the wily leggie will be their biggest threat today. Australia did well to survive yesterday evening and they would look to build on that. The third day of a Test match is often considered to be the moving day and let's wait and watch which way it moves.
... DAY 3, FIRST SESSION ...

Earlier in the day, Asad Shafiq and Haris Sohail kept Australia at bay, albeit there was hardly any scoring for quite a long period of time. Australia will be looking to emulate that. They need another 253 to avoid the follow-on but they need to take it step by step, hour by hour. They have largely struggled to bat for even a day of late, in testing conditions and the 'home' side will surely test their memory. Join us at 1000 local (0600 GMT) for all the action from Day 3. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Pakistan would have hoped that they get a wicket or two before the close of play but they will be pretty much happy with the purchase their spinners got. Yasir almost got Finch out a couple of times in the 4 overs that he bowled. With the ball turning square, it will be a big test of the batsmen's patience, come Day 3.

Finch has looked troubled against the moving and the spinning ball. Abbas could not hit the right length while the Victorian was all at sea against the spinners. Khawaja, on the other hand, has played the role of a senior player pretty well. Has looked unperturbed and oozed confidence.

Something to take for Australia in this hot day of cricket. They were able to bowl out Pakistan, but literally struggled with the ball and the heat. However, with the bat, apart from a couple of nervy moments, they have managed to keep all 10 wickets intact for Tuesday.
'Australia survive!' comments Bazid Khan on air. It is indeed a bit of an achievement for the tourists. However, Pakistan will not be too unhappy looking at the way their spinners bowled.
Around middle and leg, Khawaja goes back and defends. STUMPS ON DAY 2, AUSTRALIA TRAIL BY 452!
Full and around off, UK lunges and blocks.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Landed outside off, spinning a long way, Usman lets it go.
Short and outside off, stays low a touch, Khawaja looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Debutant Bilal Asif to bowl the last over of the day.

Flighted ball around off, Usman drives this to the right of mid on to get a run. He will retain strike for the last over of the day. Australia have survived the threat of the leggie, for today, as Yasir has bowled his last ball of the day. The tourists though will have to play a lot better tomorrow if they want to succeed against the wily spinner.
Tossed up around off, Khawaja defends with a straight bat.
Usman skips down the track but defends as he is not to the pitch of it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

A bit shorter of full length around off, turning away from the right-hander. Finch goes back and punches it to covers and takes off for a risky single. The man there runs to his left, picks up the ball and fires it to Sarfraz but by then Usman is in his crease. Seems like Finch was desperate to get off strike to avoid the Yasir threat.
Starts with a tossed up ball attacking the stumps. Finch keeps it out off the front foot. Yasir has 5 more balls with him to make an impact today.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
On middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Very full, Khawaja looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads, which rolls back to the bowler.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
A tad short, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Flighted and full on off, Khawaja drives it politely to mid off.
A slower ball on middle and leg is turned into the square leg region for a single and Finch is off strike.

Brave or silly? The result determines it. Finch goes down the track looking to smash this over the long off fence but mistimes it completely. The fielder at mid off is seen running back to try and catch it but luckily for Aaron it evades him and he again survives the Yasir threat. Gets a brace for that risky shot.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Very full this on and around off, defended by Finch off the front foot.
Starts the fresh over with a long hop, it is short outside off turning into Usman, the southpaw pulls it through square leg and gets off strike.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Big appeal for LBW but turned down. The captain and the bowler have a chat in the middle to decide whether to go for the review or not and in the end they decide against it. A very full ball  on middle and leg, Finch goes down looking to sweep but misses to get rapped on the pads. Good decision by the Asian team not to go for the review as the replays show the ball was missing the leg pole.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, pushed towards mid on again.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, that is pushed towards cover.
Here comes the Professor. Mohammad Hafeez into the attack.

Beaten! Yasir lands this full and outside off, Khawaja comes forward to defend expecting the ball to turn in but is surprised to see the ball skid off the surface and beat his outside edge. He too survives the Yasir threat.
Usman dances down the track to this flighted ball and does well to block the ball.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
A bit fuller on off, Khawaja tries to block but gets rapped on the pads. The impact is way outside off.
FOUR! Brave batting by Usman! Looking to get Yasir off his line and length.Flighted and full around off, Khawaja skips down the track and whacks it over mid on for a confident boundary.
Tossed up on off, tapped into the off side.
Outside off, played towards point.
Probably a slower ball, slips it down the leg side, Finch lets it go through to the keeper. The ball barely carries.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed towards the off side.
Full again, straight once more, driven towards silly mid on.
A length ball, pretty straight, defended back to the bowler.
Flighted again but a bit shorter than full length, Usman keeps it out off the back foot.
Slower and full in length as Yasir gives this a bit more air, Khawaja leans forward and drives to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A similar delivery this but this time Aaron gets some bat on it and deflects it towards the square leg region to get off strike. He will be happy to watch from the other end, I am sure.

Massive appeal but given not out. Pakistan don't go for the review, seems as if it is missing the leg pole. Yasir keeps it a bit shorter of full length around middle, Finch expects the ball to turn away and hence goes back looking to punch through the off side. However, the ball lands and skids through, rapping Aaron on his pads. The Pakistan players go up in unison but the umpire negates them. Replay shows that the ball was clipping the leg stump. Finch survives the Yasir threat, as of now.
A loosener from Yasir as he lands this a touch short outside off. Khawaja rocks back and punches this through covers to get three runs.
Yasir Shah comes into the attack. It will be interesting to see how much purchase he is able to get off this surface.
A bit short around off, Finch has punched that ball through the off side.
This will happen once in a while if you are attacking the stumps, Abbas strays on the batsman's pads and Finch is good enough a batsman to flick it through square leg for a couple of runs.
A mirror image of the first delivery of the over and a duplicate shot played by Aaron.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Punched off the back foot by Finch into the cover region.
Nice and aggressive bowling this by the Pakistan opening pacers. Abbas keeps this on a length attacking the stumps, Finch pushes it softly, straight down the ground.
A bit shorter in length angling into Finch, the opener whips it off his hips through deep square leg and picks a run to retain strike.

Brilliant fielding effort. Wahab dishes this fast delivery on a good length around off, Usman opens the bat-face looking to run it down through the third man region. Imam at gully dives to his right and makes a superb save. He has a shy at the striker's end and hits the stumps, but Finch is well in.
Good length ball around off is pushed into the off side.
A bit shorter in length on the stumps, kept out by Usman off the back foot.
Riaz bangs this one a bit shorter in length angling into Usman, the southpaw swivels well and pulls it through deep square leg to pick up another brace.
Dishes this on a good length just around off. Good start by both the bowlers as they are making the batsmen play as much as possible. Khawaja defends off the front foot.
A similar ball around off, Finch comes forward in a solid defense.
Abbas finds his line and length and lands this around off, Aaron gives it the deserving respect by defending it off the front foot.
Similar ball but this time the attacking right-hander drives it dead straight with better timing and picks up a brace.
Fuller and straighter on the stumps, Finch drives straight down the ground but it is cut off by the fielder at mid off.
A bit shorter in length this outside off, Khawaja opens the bat face and with the angle glides this through third man to get three runs.
A good length ball around off is blocked out solidly by Usman.
Keeps the last ball of the over fractionally short of a good length just outside off, Aaron punches it but it goes straight to covers.
Wide of off, Finch shoulders arms to let that one through.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Off the mark in Test cricket is Aaron Finch. A similar ball again on his hips but this time he finds the gap through square leg and earns a brace to get his innings underway.
Similar ball, similar shot and fielded by the same fielder at square leg.
A bit shorter of a good length angling into the batsman's body, Finch flicks it to square leg.
Wahab Riaz to share the new ball.
Abbas needs to make the batsman play in this short passage of play remaining. He again keeps this wide of off and Usman points his bat skywards.
Again outside off, again a leave.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Dishes this outside off again and Khawaja lets it be. Don't think he will flirt with these right now.
Wide of off, Usman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Abbas dishes this full and a bit wide of off, Khawaja caresses this through covers to get himself and his team off the mark with a brace.
